steps.content: [WhiteSands Market]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You WhiteSands punks have no f**king shame! The whole lot of you ganging up on one little girl? Come and fight me one-on-one... hiyaa!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Get her!!
More bandits close in. Escape is Hella's specialty, but this isn't Syndicate, and Hella is unfamiliar with the terrain. She soon gets surrounded.
Hella jumps onto a pile of goods, whacking whoever tries to approach. As she swings her pipe, someone grabs her arm from behind, pulling her backward.
Follow me! This way!
Hella is led through twists and turns, running around the market several times before finally ducking into a hidden corner.
The two squat behind a wooden fence. The desert bandits don't notice this little hideout and run past, shouting. Hella, panting heavily, finally gets a chance to look at her "savior."
Korryn notices her gaze and turns to smile back at Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Are you that bounty hunter?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Yup, that's me. The best bounty hunter in WhiteSands. And this is my trusty partner—Sheriff the Lizard.
The lizard flicks its tail at Hella to say hi.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: You can call me Korryn, or any other nice words you can think of. It's all good.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: As for you, little one... are you a cop or with the Legion?
Korryn looks at Hella inquisitively. The scrapes from her recent fight are healing rapidly. Hella's eyes dart around, and she quickly speaks up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why would the cops hire a child? We Legionnaires are the mortal enemies of the cops. We beat them up, stole their clothes, then beat up the desert bandits in their clothes. It's all a misunderstanding.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If we weren't so scattered now, I would have summoned 800 fellow Legionnaires to pummel them silly!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Well, that's not important now. Getting away is our priority! Could you please cover me, pretty lady? The Legion will definitely thank you big time later.
The bounty hunter ponders, seemingly not convinced that a kid can offer much of a reward.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Thank me, huh? How big of a reward are we talking about? We bounty hunters have a clear price tag.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'll thank you with a chariot! Plus a month's salary of some big dummy as your pocket money!
The bluff slips out easily. Korryn pauses, then bursts into laughter.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Salary... hahaha! Alright then, for the sake of our fateful encounter!
She pulls out the crumpled wanted poster from her pocket, showing the desert bandit's portrait to Hella.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: The desert bandits chasing you just stole someone else's Hypercube, but they didn't keep an eye on it. Now they're taking it out on you, thinking you're the thief who stole their loot.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: These guys are incompetent, but they hold grudges like no other. It's not easy to escape. Let me think...
Footsteps echo on the other side of the fence. Korryn quickly holds her breath, shielding Hella with her body, and looks out warily.
The desert bandits are back. There's only one path outside the hiding spot, and they'll soon search here.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: S**t! We're cornered...!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Don't worry.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: These desert bandits always stick together. Beat them on the left and more will come from the right. It's like fighting cockroaches. They're not that strong, but just won't die.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: However, this fighting style has many loopholes. If you find a gap in their encirclement, you can easily slip away.
Korryn speaks in a lighthearted manner, as if everything is under control, and that beating the desert bandits is as simple as swatting bugs.
Hella can hardly see Korryn's backlit face clearly, but she can't help but grab her outstretched hand.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: By the way, what's your name, miss?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hella! I just go by Hella!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Nice to meet you, little Hella. It's a bit sudden, but get ready and take a deep breath...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Time to make a run for it!
Before the girl can react, Korryn yanks Hella into her arms and kicks over the wooden fence in front of them.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit
steps.content: So there you are! Get 'em, boys!
The bandit leader barely finishes his sentence before Korryn kicks him over.
Hella staggers as Korryn pulls her forward. She looks up and sees Korryn's big smile.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Let's go! I'm gonna take you for some thrills!
